limits: Lifecycle is one machine, loopback HTTP and independent directories/inodes, not separate physical disks/hosts or a production TaskFlow owner integration.
Publication is single-writer SQLite CAS. A failpoint exception before pointer commit is tested; power-loss durability, multiwriter consensus and arbitrary network partitions are not.

All five seeds show old values can still be served before explicit source delivery. The coordinator replays source updates and distributes full bundles. Automatic distributed revocation is not demonstrated.
Lifecycle requests choose operations directly and therefore do not measure natural-language routing.

RPC counts include failed read attempts and old pinned clients; bytes are attempted JSON requests and received JSON response bodies, excluding HTTP/TCP framing. Migration bytes are application bytes, excluding filesystem metadata I/O.

Parent and reaped child CPU are separate cumulative scopes. Internal costs are nested within outer execution costs and must not be added twice. RSS high-water marks are neither aggregate concurrent memory nor steady-state model memory.
Five study seeds randomize small synthetic opaque key associations. Learning/read cohorts overlap and are written-support recall, not independent future-task generalization.

Cells train real NumPy tanh MLP association weights with explicit output catalogs; frozen linguistic encoder/head training is a separate experiment. These are not language-model memory finetunes or answers stored exclusively in parameters.

Replay vs no-replay shares initial parameters/catalog and 400 optimizer steps, but uses 12800 vs 3200 example presentations. The measured 7.5 percentage-point retention gain is not an equal-compute causal result.
The semantic cell calibration has three already-trained addresses per seed, selects threshold zero, and explicitly disclaims population risk guarantees. It is not independent held-out calibration.

Clean rebuilding is verified against an independently initialized deterministic same-data fit and by excluding revoked/superseded lineage. Statistical unlearning/privacy is not proved; immutable source/history artifacts remain retained.
Procedure inference selects among five pre-registered arithmetic opcodes. Cross-type arithmetic is independently recomputed here, but new program invention is not shown.

Serialized current cells are larger than the compressed exact source ledger on this small workload. Full retained files also include candidate artifacts, training history, source ledgers and diagnostics; no full-cost storage-compression win is shown.

Three historical copied source.sqlite files per seed were subsequently updated through explicit delivery, so historical migration hashes are checked as manifests and current immutable files are verified; current final successor source files are fully hash-verified.
The current_three_cells_bytes field sums semantic, procedure and new-domain semantic cell files. It is not a sum of the event/semantic/procedure type inventory; the event store remains separate.
This posthoc audit recomputes recorded results and hashes without rerunning models, opening main language evaluation data, changing repo source/tests or making commits.
